classes.subject: PMA

notes.descrlong: Taught in Los Angeles. This Winter Session class is offered by the School of Continuing Education and Summer Sessions. For details visit http://www.sce.cornell.edu/ws/courses/courses.php?v=3320

classes.description: This course explores the fundamentals of writing for the screen both in a classroom setting and on the ground in Los Angeles. he immersive class format includes creative writing assignments, class discussion, screenings and workshops, complimented by field trips to interview working professionals in film, television and media. Students will produce short film scripts and feedback on student work, culminating in the revision of an original film script.
classes.catalogFee: Student will be responsible for all trip expenses and arrangements; expenses to include: travel, lodging, food, and transportation while in LA.
